result.summary: Found 2 major issues: restaurant card text truncation and incomplete card content visibility at the bottom of the screen affecting readability and usability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and incomplete, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar
issues.suggestion: Ensure full restaurant names are visible by either increasing card width, reducing font size, or using text ellipsis with a tooltip on full names that don't fit

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section at the bottom shows partially cut-off restaurant cards. The second restaurant's name and details are not fully visible, making it unclear what establishment is being shown
issues.suggestion: Adjust layout spacing or card height to ensure complete restaurant information (name, rating, delivery time) is visible before the bottom navigation bar

issues.description: The horizontal scrolling in both 'Fastest near you' and category filter sections could have more obvious affordance to indicate more content is available
issues.suggestion: Add subtle visual cues like a partially visible card edge or scroll indicator to make horizontal scrolling more discoverable to users
